title: Industry Day - Host Nation Payroll & Timekeeping Services - Updated
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC SIGONELLA.NAVSUP FLC SIGONELLA NAPLES OFFICE
detail_text: Industry Day: Host Nation Payroll and Timekeeping Software Services - CANCELED CANCELLATION NOTICE: This notice is to inform you that the Industry Day for Host Nation Payroll and Timekeeping Services previously scheduled for 9 April 2026 is canceled until further notice. We appreciate the questions submitted by interested parties. We anticipate providing a response to all questions received at a later date. We thank you for your interest in this requirement. Please continue to monitor SAM.GOV for further updates. __________________________________ NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Sigonella, Naples Detachment (FLCSI-N) invites you to attend a virtual Industry Day to discuss an upcoming requirement for Host Nation Payroll and Timekeeping Software Services & Support. This virtual event is an opportunity for the Navy to present the technical requirements, gather industry feedback, and foster open communication. A DRAFT Performance Work Statement (PWS) is attached for your review. All interested federal contractors, both large and small, are encouraged to attend. There is no cost for this event. Key Details : Event: Host Nation Payroll & Timekeeping Software Services Date & Time : CANCELLED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE Location: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (Link provided at registration) Advance Questions Deadline: CLOSED How to Register : To register for the event, please send an e-mail by 31 March 2026 deadline To: patricia.r.folts.civ@us.navy.mil and Michael.a.sands17.civ@us.navy.mil Subject Line: HN Payroll Industry Day Registration [Insert Company Name] Body of Email: Company Name, Cage Code, Attendee(s) Name, Title, and Email Address A Microsoft Teams link for or audio and visual access will be sent to all timely registrants one to two days prior to the event. A conference call dial-in number will also be provided for those unable to use Teams. Advanced Questions & Answers - CLOSED A Q&A summary will be made available after the event and posted to SAM.GOV. ____________________________________________________________________ Note: This event does not constitute a specific offer or commitment by the Navy to fund, in whole or in part, any opportunities referenced herein. Neither the planning nor the establishment of an Industry Day constitutes a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a Request for Quote (RFQ). Participation in the Industry Day, as well as current and/or follow-on Requests for Information, is neither mandatory nor is it a requisite to future participation by a contractor in any future contract RFP/RFQ. Responders are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this Industry Day notice.
